verdict.rationale: Consensus explicitly supports importing a personal corpus (PDF, BibTeX, RIS, Zotero) into a searchable AI-powered Library, and the Library is described as letting users 'search, find gaps, and put your collection to work' — a plausible fit for 'research over my own PDFs.' However, the evidence never confirms that full synthesis/screening/extraction (the literature-review and full-text analysis features) applies specifically to uploaded PDFs versus the pre-indexed 200M-paper corpus, and there's no hands-on confirmation of quality on arbitrary user PDFs. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that synthesis/Q&A/full-text extraction works on user-uploaded PDFs (not just corpus papers), and independent/hands-on validation of this workflow.
